notes.title: Driving Is Hard - Driving Is Insane Update! v5.0
notes.content:
Driving Is Hard – Driving Is Insane Update! V5.0
We went full throttle with this one. A brand new hard mode, slick skins, and big under-the-hood improvements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/f2c8b17a5c49c466e5a80f60d233e66a7829d0a4.gif

New Features

 Insane Mode – new no parachute gamemode with a few checkpoints. Driving Is Hard must be completed to play this.
 New Skins – Unlockable lootbox and completion achievement skins.
 Discord Button – Found a bug? Smash that button.


Improvements

 Fully rewritten loading system – loads a bit slower, but uses way less memory and makes future updates tiny.
 Better & more unstuck points (though getting stuck should be close to impossible).
 Removed all Father voice lines.
 ~10% FPS boost
 Localization polish – improved localization texts



Community Spotlight 🐐
A huge thank you to the organizers and players who put together a chill Driving Is Hard showmatch featuring 4 GOATs of the game! Pitrau, Warryan, Miztix, Lockness.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/00d7a389642977a0efe4e3fbd51ef4fa0eb03343.png

Pulling off a clean run isn’t easy—mad respect to the drivers. 💪 Thanks for showing the game some love!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/f3682d01f4928cff503bef6de3cadbe9fd66c623.png

notes.title: Driving Is Hard - Skin Update! v4.0 🎨
notes.content:
Driving Is Hard - Skin Update! v4.0
Jeff is getting a makeover! This update introduces bath and character customization, letting you collect and equip cool new skins while tackling the toughest roads.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/be752bbc3af75515d183a260a3082ccdd3ad8fe8.gif

New Feature - Collectible Skins!

 Customize Jeff with unique outfits and accessories.
 Explore the world to find hidden collectibles scattered across different levels.
 Show off your style as you struggle and succeed through brutal driving challenges!


Improvements

 Reflections - Improved reflection quality and made the metals look better
 Sounds - Improve sounds all over the map
 Ragdoll - Make Jeff react to external forces more
 Steam Deck - made the UI larger and default visual settings Potato for better first-hand experience


Fixes

 Ghost Flip - Fixed the ghost flip which used to happen at the apex of the jump.
 Resolve Stucks - We had two locations where people stucked. Now we don’t.
 Flickering Trees - Fix a few trees that caused visual flickers.


Update your game and start hunting for skins! Whether you drive in style or chaos, the challenge remains the same - Driving Is Hard.

🚗💨 Happy driving!

notes.title: Driving Is Hard – Driving is Easy Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180705/7e18ba1d97818f53f6fe2da301bb7aac53241d67.png

Driving Is Hard – Driving is Easy Update!
We’ve been busy under the hood, and we’re excited to bring you an update packed with new features, improvements, and fixes!

Driving Is Easy Mode
A new, more forgiving game mode for those who want less pain and more fun!
Set checkpoints by toggling lanterns and respawn after crashes.
Perfect for players who want to enjoy the wild ride without the brutal challenge.

Quality-of-Life Settings
Auto Rotation – Toggle automatic camera rotation to keep your cam aligned.
Speedlines – Turn speed lines on or off based on your style.
Dynamic FOV – Toggle dynamic field-of-view whenever you like.
Restart Button – Add a restart button for quicker resets—great for speedrunners!

Improvements
Improved Credits Screen - Added Respawn Counter and Grandpa Race Track statistics.
Performance Boost - Potato settings now deliver even better performance for low-end machines.

Fixes
Speedrun Areas - Patched a few sneaky shortcuts in the Treehouse and City Rooftops.
Linux Glitches - Visual glitches on Potato settings have been resolved.
Tree Flickering - Trees no longer flicker—enjoy a glitch-free view of nature!

:fire: Update your game and try out the new Driving Is Easy mode! And don’t worry—Driving Is Hard is still as punishing as ever for those who seek the challenge.
Happy driving! :wheel::bathtub:
